scope: Full P1 label/exclusion sensitivity; manuscript unchanged; exploratory retrospective rerun.

source_alternative.labels: Use original provider binary side: AK negative, KA positive. SCCIS remains its own subtype; no diagnostic re-adjudication.
source_alternative.folds: Previously frozen v2 duplicate-component folds retained for all 4978 components; existing 4717 folds and representatives identical.
source_alternative.other_exclusions: 224 non-histopathology and 33 overlap candidates remain excluded; same five duplicate merges.

steps: Expanded-source refit with original isolated backbone/fusion/threshold recipe
Expanded-source refit of the five original low-flag representation arms and original held-out threshold repair
Reference and alternative endpoint definitions on all available newly fitted tables
Formal SCCIS/IEC same-floor rename equivalence check
Independent integer allocation validation and preserved-version check

fitting.initialization: Same ImageNet weights for isolated backbones; original fixed warm-start checkpoint for the separate low-flag arm recipe.
fitting.calibration: Next MILK fold excluded from backbone fitting and validation; all external outcomes excluded from source fitting.
fitting.stopping: Original source validation and early-stopping rules; no target-dependent reruns or hyperparameter search.
fitting.lowflag: Keep original external group folds, arm recipes, warm-start checkpoints and target/reference definitions; add source AK/KA to source fits. No evaluation-fold labels enter selection/repair.

targets: Original reference targets; imaging 10/15/20% for source SP, 15/20% for primary/repaired. Each table is a configuration, not an independent patient.
equivalence: Changing SCCIS to IEC at the same 90% floor is a permutation/rename, not a new clinical target.
